name: Sit upright for one minute
short_description: Sit upright for one minute once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can sit upright for one minute in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Sit upright for one minute means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Sit upright for one minute in a fresh real-life scenario.
